instruction.name: xvldrepl.h
instruction.description: Read 16-bit data from memory address `addr + offset`, replicate the data to all vector lanes and save into `dst`. Address misalignment does not raise an exception. The `offset` operand is a byte offset, matching the assembly immediate; the encoded instruction stores it as a scaled immediate for wider elements.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvldrepl.h $xr0, $r20, 0; xvldrepl.h $xr1, $r20, 2; xvldrepl.h $xr2, $r20, 4; xvldrepl.h $xr3, $r20, 6; xvldrepl.h $xr4, $r20, 8; xvldrepl.h $xr5, $r20, 10; xvldrepl.h $xr6, $r20, 12; xvldrepl.h $xr7, $r20, 14
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4' --asm 'xvldrepl.h $xr0, $r20, 0; xvldrepl.h $xr1, $r20, 2; xvldrepl.h $xr2, $r20, 4; xvldrepl.h $xr3, $r20, 6; xvldrepl.h $xr4, $r20, 8; xvldrepl.h $xr5, $r20, 10; xvldrepl.h $xr6, $r20, 12; xvldrepl.h $xr7, $r20, 14'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
